description.short: Project-managed HVE Squad planning and delivery in Cowork
description.full: Connects GUID-bound OneDrive or SharePoint projects to the HVE Squad Coordinator through squad_run. Presents server notices and questions, saves explicit answers, submits them through squad_respond with Squad.Run, verifies receipts, and resumes the same run. Operator approval remains separate through squad_approve with Squad.Operate. Mirrors canonical server files and maintains a stakeholder library of deliverables, pending decisions and next steps. Reports missing capabilities honestly; no native execution or deployment.

agentConnectors.description: Enter through squad_run. Relay explicit same-run human answers with squad_respond; keep operator squad_approve separate. Poll existing runs, retrieve outputs with read-only squad_history, and mirror server files.
